QR zone, from 80 to 96 percent of the height: a big white rounded card. On its left, an empty, perfectly blank, pure white square about 30 percent of the image width with a thin dark outline; a QR code will be printed there later, so draw nothing at all inside it. On its right, the big bold words 扫码开玩 in dark ink with a thick coral arrow pointing left to the square, and a round coral sticker badge with cream text 3 分钟.
